header_sentences: See Word (of the Lord), and rar.

contexts.text: The words of the letter are represented in the World of Spirits to the very life, in a beautiful order...
Words that are applicable solely to the antediluvians.
The words were one () = that there was one doctrine in particular. For lip = doctrine in general, and words, doctrine in particular, or the particulars of doctrine.
That a word = all doctrine concerning charity and the derivative faith; and words, the things of doctrine. Illustrated.
By taking heed according to Thy word... Thy word have I laid up in mine heart... I do not forget Thy word (); word, in these passages, = doctrine in general.
To ride upon the word of truth () = to teach the doctrine of truth... AC 2761:6.
Jehovah sent a word unto Jacob, and it lath lighted upon Israel () = the doctrine of worship, external and internal.

Man (liveth) by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God (). When anyone heareth the word of the kingdom, and heedeth it not, then cometh the evil one, and snatcheth away that which was sown in his heart (). Heaven and earth shall pass away, but My word shall not pass away (). In these passages, word = the Lord's doctrine; and words, the things that are of His doctrine.
As words = all things of doctrine, the commandments are called words. Illustrated.
The historicals are representative, and all the words significative. Explained. AC 1540. AC 1783.
It is the affection that lies hidden in the words that constitutes the internal sense here; the words of the letter are not attended to...
For the Lord alone is Discourse and Word.

After these words, the word of Jehovah came to Abram in a vision () = that after the combats in childhood there was a revelation... Words, in the Hebrew language, = Things, here, the Things accomplished... The word of Jehovah to Abram is nothing else than the Lord's word to Himself; but in His childhood... it could not appear otherwise than as a revelation. AC 1801.
On account of the word of Sarah () = the whole transaction...
It came to pass after these words () = the Things transacted relating to those who are within the Church; for words = Things. In the Original Language, Things are called words. Explained. AC 6219.
The servant told Isaac all the words that he had done ()... The words = the Things.
Thought and will conjoin, not words. In this world words do conjoin; but only when the hearer believes that the speaker thinks and wills what is good.
See(of the Lord) here.
Bring me word again () = Knowledge. Explained.

After these words () = after the things that precede; for words, in the Original Language, are Things as well as words... The reason the words in the Original Language = Things also, is that words, in the internal sense, = the truths of doctrine; and therefore all Divine truth in general is called the word.... And, as nothing that comes forth in the universe is anything, that is, a Thing, unless it is from Divine good by Divine truth, therefore the words in the Hebrew are also Things. Illustrated.

This is the word that I spake unto Pharaoh () = that which the Natural had thought... for a word = a Thing... Thus This is the word = this is the Thing... As to word, in the Original Language, a Thing is expressed by a word, and therefore a Divine revelation is called a word; and, in the supreme sense, the Lord also; and, by the word, when predicated of the Lord, or of a revelation that is from Him, there is signified, in the proximate sense, the Divine truth, from which come forth all Things that are. AC 5283.
For the words and tones with which the thoughts clothed, are nothing but additions...
I watch over My word... () = (over) the truth.
He spake unto them these words () = the influx of this Thing... for words = Things; moreover, in the Original Language, a Thing is expressed by this word. AC 5754. AC 5755.
I will do according to thy word () = that so it shall be done.
Spirits do not apprehend a man's words as a man hears them, but as the man thinks.
I am not a man of words () = that (the truth Divine) has not the faculty of speech. Explained.
All the words of Jehovah () = the several things of doctrine.
Tomorrow shall Jehovah do this word () = that this will be with them for ever.
And Jehovah did this word () = the effect.
He that feared the word of Jehovah () = the things that are of the Lord. AC 7564.
Ye shall keep this word... () = that all this shall be observed.
Is not this the word... () = such a thing; for this word = this Thing.
Gather the word of a day in its day ()... a word = the Thing of which it is said, here, the manna.
This is the word that Jehovah hath commanded () = a command about it from the Divine; for a word = the Thing that is treated of. AC 8524.
The proprium from which they will not act, is signified by nor speaking a word ().
When they have a word () = in everything that happens; for a word = a Thing that happens. AC 8698.
The word is too heavy for thee () = that it is not possible; for a heavy word = [a Thing] that is not possible.
Bring thou the words to God () = mediation and intercession. AC 8729.
Every great word they shall bring to thee () = everything from (it). AC 8718. AC 8720.
These are the words that thou shalt speak... () = influx to receive truths. AC 8774.
God spake all these words, saying () = truths Divine for those in the Heavens and on the earth. AC 8862, Explained.
What is inwardly contained in the words of speech is plainly perceived there.
Upon every word of transgression () = whatever injury and loss.
The word coming to God () = examination by means of truth.
From the word of a lie () = from falsity of evil.

Perverteth the words of the just () = so that they appear like truths of good... for words = the Things themselves, thus truths... The reason words = truths, is that word, in the Original Language = that which is something, and that really exists... From this it is that Divine truth is called the word.
To hear the words, or discourses () = to learn and know the precepts of faith that are from the Lord.

All the words of Jehovah, and all the judgments () = those things in the Word that are of life in a spiritual and a natural state. The words of Jehovah = those things in the Word that are of life in a spiritual state. Explained.
All the words that Jehovah hath spoken we will do () = reception then in the heart; for the words that Jehovah hath spoken = truths from the Word that are of life.
Moses wrote all the words of Jehovah () = an imprinting on the life (of the) truths from the Word.

(The covenant) that Jehovah hath made with you upon all these words () = that there is conjunction with the Lord through each and all things of the Word... All these words = each and all things of the Word; for the laws promulgated from Sinai, in the universal sense, = all Divine truth, thus the Word as to each and all things.

The ten words = all the truths that are of doctrine, and the goods that are of life. ( = all truths I Divine in (the Word). AC 10688.) ( = all truths in the complex. DLife 62.) ( = all truths, for they include them. AR 101:2.) TCR 286. AE 1024:2.
Everyone that hath words, let him come to (Aaron and Hur) () = that falsities are to be removed therefrom; to have words = to dispute about truths; for words = truths.
To speak the words of God () = Divine truths.
The words that I speak unto you, they are spirit and they are life (); the words that the Lord has spoken = Divine truths.
The word of Jehovah = the Divine truth.
Explained.
To speak a word () = to think such things.
The people heard this evil word, and they mourned () = their grief because they were not to be pre-eminent to others.
I will write on the tables the words... () = ... interior Divine things, thus those which are of the internal sense, (and are) of love and of faith.
Write for thyself these words () = the primary truths that are to be remembered and done. For by words are signified, in general, Things; in special, truths...
These are the words that Jehovah hath commanded, to do them () = instruction about the primary thing of the Church, to which all things relate... for these things are said about the Sabbath.

Thus the Lord inspired the words which the Spirits dictated to the prophets... And, as the words came forth immediately from the Lord, they were each filled with the Divine, and contain in themselves an internal sense...
The words of the prophecy () = the doctrine of the New Jerusalem. ( = the truths that are of the doctrine of Heaven. AE 14.)
On those who love mere elegance of words, and plays upon words.
The more the meaning of words is looked at, the less are the words attended to...
Looking at words is attended with this - that the mind is distracted from the meanings, and sticks in the words...

The Angels perceive nothing but the intention, end, or will; they know not their words; and therefore when the intention, end, and will... are good, the words may fall as they do fall, provided... that nothing be said except what the person thinks.
To hear the word of the kingdom () = the truths of the Church.
Thou hast observed My word () = made of life the truths from the Word. AE 214. AR 179. AR 185.
To ride upon the word of Truth () = to act from Divine good through Divine truth. AE 298:7.
To do the Lord's words () = the good of life; for truth, when a man does it, becomes good.
If a man love Me, he will keep My words ()... because His commandments, and words = Divine truths, and all Divine truth proceeds from Him, and that which proceeds from Him is Himself.
Words () = dogmas.
The words that he shall speak against the Most High () = falsities destroying the truths of the Church.
That I may eat Thy words () = to appropriate His precepts, or Divine truths. So in .
Through the word of their testimony () = through the confession and acknowledgement of the Divine in His Human.
A word against the Son of Man () = to interpret the natural sense of the Word according to appearances. AE 778:6, Explained.
In a word.
These are the true words of God () = that they are from the Lord, who is the Word, and who is the Truth.
